messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: job seekers in Singapore with mixed digital comfort, time pressure and trust in online tools; include a cautious one, a hurried one, a sceptical one, a low-digital-skill one
Kind of persona: job_seeker (a person looking for work in Singapore)
Number of personas: 2
Variation axes (spread the set across these): experience level, digital comfort, time pressure, trust in AI tools, industry, confidence
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): read six short employer-check results and say what each means about the employer and what they would do next

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "job_seeker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}
Already created (make these clearly different): ['Mid‑career accountant, low digital trust', 'Young marketing graduate, high time pressure', 'Senior engineer, cautious about AI credibility', 'Entry‑level retail worker, minimal digital skills']

content:
{
  "personas": [
    {
      "persona_id": "cautious-analyst",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Mid‑career analyst, low AI trust, moderate time pressure",
      "first_name": "Rohit",
      "background": "Rohit, 38, holds a Singapore PR and has ten years of experience in financial analysis at multinational firms. He recently relocated to Singapore after his spouse got a new role, and his current contract ended three months ago.",
      "situation_now": "Scanning job portals daily, he has applied to five analyst positions and is waiting for interview callbacks.",
      "goals": [
        "Secure a stable full‑time analyst role in finance",
        "Maintain a work‑life balance for family commitments",
        "Earn a salary that supports his children's education"
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Limited time – needs to review applications before evenings with kids",
        "Low trust in AI‑generated employer insights",
        "Prefers clear, factual information over flashy UI"
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "medium",
      "reading_style": "Reads headlines first, then skims bullet points; pauses on any metric he cannot verify.",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Skeptical – worries AI may exaggerate or omit key risks.",
      "known_gaps": [
        "May misinterpret statistical confidence scores",
        "Unfamiliar with AI‑driven sentiment tags"
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Favors companies with transparent financial reporting",
        "Avoids startups lacking clear governance"
      ],
      "voice": "I prefer a straightforward, no‑fluff summary before I decide to dig deeper.",
      "simulation_notes": "If the employer‑check results contain jargon or AI‑generated ratings, he will pause, look for a source link, and may abandon the task after 4 minutes if not convinced."
    },
    {
      "persona_id": "hurried-graduate",
      "kind": "job_seeker",
      "label": "Young marketing graduate, high time pressure, low digital skill",
      "first_name": "Jia",
      "background": "Jia, 24, Singapore citizen, just finished a marketing degree and has been interning part‑time at a boutique agency. Her tuition loan repayment starts next month, and she needs a full‑time role quickly.",
      "situation_now": "She is juggling part‑time gigs while scrolling job listings on her phone between shifts.",
      "goals": [
        "Land a marketing associate job within two weeks",
        "Start earning enough to cover loan repayments",
        "Gain a foothold in a reputable firm"
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Very limited time – can only spare 5‑10 minutes per session",
        "Low digital literacy – uncomfortable with complex dashboards",
        "Relies heavily on visual cues and simple language"
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "low",
      "reading_style": "Skims rapidly, relies on icons and colour‑coded scores; reads full text only if something looks promising.",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Cautiously optimistic – sees AI as a shortcut but worries about errors.",
      "known_gaps": [
        "May overlook nuanced warnings in fine print",
        "Confuses confidence percentages with guarantee of job fit"
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Prefers employers that highlight employee benefits visually",
        "Tends to click on the first result that looks 'modern'"
      ],
      "voice": "Give me the quick take‑aways so I can decide in a minute.",
      "simulation_notes": "If the six employer‑check results are not summarized with clear icons or brief bullet points, she will scroll past them after about 2 minutes."
    }
  ]
}
